summary: This Form 8-K reports the sale of unregistered limited partnership units by TPG Private Equity Opportunities, L.P. as part of its continuous private offering, with aggregate consideration of $89.2 million for the Fund and $102.5 million for the Fund Complex. No transaction price per unit, premium, or expected close date is stated; it is a routine capital raise under Regulation D. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a routine periodic update on unregistered sales and valuation methodology, not a special situation transaction. As a non-US equivalent, it is a standard private placement notice.
